coordinate_system.native: Source board XY: origin lower-left electronics/top face, Y toward USB end. Native layer1 electronics, layer2 user-facing.
coordinate_system.user: Origin lower-left as viewed at keycap side with USB end at top. X=59.69-nativeX; Y=nativeY. For Blender user face can be+Z. Place electronics on negative Z.
coordinate_system.user_z_reference: Set user-facing PCB surface=Z0; substrate from -1.6 to0; user controls positiveZ, electronics below-1.6.
coordinate_system.native_local_transform: For component local(x,y), negate localY if native layer2; rotate counterclockwise by native_rotation_deg; add native_xy. For user view then mirror globalX.
coordinate_system.native_rotation_caveat: native_local_x_axis differs from EAGLE local package frame for imported rotated parts. Do not apply native angle to upstream STEP without calibration.

texture_mapping.bottom_png: Already horizontally mirrored for user-facing view. Left pixel is userX=-1, top pixel is userY=105.14. For XY plane UV=(userX+1)/61.69,(userY+1)/106.14. Do not mirror bottom.png again.
texture_mapping.top_png: Top/electronics image is native coordinates. For face-up scene XY point use U=(59.69-userX+1)/61.69,V=(userY+1)/106.14. Flip normal/textureorientation to suit mesh.
texture_mapping.image_y_direction: PNG top to bottom corresponds decreasing native/userY.

oled.warning: Folding 16-pin bare panel, not 4-pin breakout; PCB source has glass outline and opposite-side connector.

encoder.knob: not specified by PCB BOM; cosmetic choice must be labeled

usb.warning: Body bounds from original package silk/docs; sourced HRO connector geometry should supersede representative shell.

mounting.user_face_projections: Nut noses, screw tips, solder must be flush/recessed at user-facing plane. Do not show screw heads on front over key zones.
